answer_1.quote: We leverage transition prompt learning and Adapter tuning to efficiently extend the transition sentence generation (TSG) in a unified NLG model with the augmented dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: transition sentences and normal responses for chit-chat or task-oriented dialogue

answer_2.quote: To evaluate generated chit-chat responses, Distinct-1 (Dis-1) and Distinct-2 (Dis-2) are used... To evaluate generated task-oriented responses, two N-gram matching metrics, BLEU and Meteor are used... a machine learned automatic metric, BERTScore is also utilized... we propose several automatic metrics to evaluate transition sentence generations: Transition accuracy, d accuracy, d-v accuracy.
